newsitem.title: POLAND: Warta sees PLN 22-25 mln net in 1997.
newsitem.headline: Warta sees PLN 22-25 mln net in 1997.

text.p: The Polish insurer TUiR Warta SA expects its net profit to rise to 22-25 million zlotys this year from 17.4 million planned for 1996, the company's president said on Monday.
"We will strive to increase our net profits each year and the planned net profit for 1997 is between 22 million and 25 million zlotys," Andrzej Witkowski told a news conference.

He said that a steady improvement in Warta's results should be possible thanks to its policy of gradually reducing the share of loss-making motor insurance in its insurance portfolio while boosting the share of profitable property insurance.
Witkowski said motor insurance now accounted for 53 percent of all Warta's business and the company would strive to bring its share to about 30 percent.
He said the firm would like property insurance to grow to 50 percent of its portfolio from the current 25 percent.
